$comment: Pass/fail limits per scenario, calibrated for the default settings (10 connections, 20 students). LOAD_MAX_P50_MS, LOAD_MAX_P95_MS, LOAD_MAX_P99_MS, LOAD_MAX_ERROR_RATE and LOAD_MIN_RPS override them for every scenario. The spec sets no targets yet: these are guard rails about 4-5x the local baseline in docs/load-testing.md, to catch order-of-magnitude regressions without flaking on a busy machine. They are not SLOs.
